name: Admin Starter (Dark)
description: Dark-theme React + Vite + Tailwind admin console with Cloudgate IdP login, a responsive sidebar shell, and sample paginated table pages (Users, Orders) backed by a bundled Cloudgate workflow API with demo data.

workflowImport.description: Creates the Admin controller (project path 'admin') with its SQLite database and the workflow endpoints the app calls at runtime.
workflowImport.publishHint: Import the bundle (creates admin_db and runs .template/schema.sql), then publish all Admin endpoints to sandbox. Verify POST /sbx/admin/dashboard {"op":"stats"} returns counts.
